title: op materials
description: this mod adds insanely op materials -tools - armors - ores that progress with you through the game with 5 tiers of achivments
body:
this mod is still under development so please if you find any problems don't hesitate and text me on discord : nangofigo. (with the . aswell don't forget it )

first this mod contain 9 new tiers of gear : vrethite , Xolumite , Glarphinium , Drevnite , Zyphonite , Quelbium , Threxonite , Vondrium , omega

each tier gets progressively stronger and faster and more durable than the one before it 

you must unlock the advancment for the current tier before you can hold or craft or use items from the next one so you can't skip straight to the end game ore (the omega ore) or use cheats except if you get the advancment grant  command or smth💔

each tool have its own ability 

swords: have a sweeping slash that damages all mobs in forward cone (scales with tier ofc)

axes : break the entire tree at once (so you don't have to use other mods for this anymore i think)

pickaxes & shovels : feature vein mining and area mining (3x3 grid) for mid tires with customizable settings for omega 

hoes : automatically replant crops and boost growth rates 

omega void mace : i did this one for the love of it i always wanted something like this and never found it 

its unbreakable and comes with 5 active superpowers you can trigger like flames , fireball , lightning , explosions , telekinsesis (grab and throw)

omega tools have config screen that you can open by holding  shift and pressing right click , or just press the keybind that you can set in the settings 

each tiers have its own crafting recipes that gets harder by time sorry about that

early tier : vrethite , Xolumite , Glarphinium , Drevnite

method of crafting : directly into a regular crafting table with the same vanillia patterns like one stick two ingots , etc 

mid tier: Zyphonite , Quelbium

method of crafting : upgraded in a crafting table , surround the previous tier's tool or armor piece with the new tier's ingot in a ful 3x3 grid as an example Glarphinium Boots in the center and surround them with 8 Zyphonite ingots to get the Zyphonite boots

late tier : Threxonite , Vondrium

Method  : Upgraded in a smithing table using the respective updare template 

Threxonite upgrade template + threxonite ingot + vondrium gear

vondrium upgrade template + vondrium ingot + threxonite gear

omega gear and void mace (end game)

method : high tier shaped recipes in a crafting table 

cores and mace:

the nangocite core is crafted by surrounding a nether star with vondrium and threxonite ingots 

the omega void mace is crafted by placing a nether star in the center flanked by two nangocite cores (left and right) and two nangocite crystals ( top and bottom).

1.0.2 update !!!

new deminsion called the omega deminsion

new tameable boss fight

after you kill the boss you will get its egg and you can tame it with few omega ingots and then make an omega saddle and you can ride it and fly with it

it also has special abilities 

and you need to kill all the gurdian golems so you can kill it

also its almost impossible to kill unless you are smart 

you can't use the omega abilities in the omega deminsion cause then it will be easy to fight the omega dragon sorry about that bro 

also a new omega bag that allows you to store up to 1000 item !! 

each tab has 100 slot for items and there is 10 tabs

also the omega dragon has inventory but thats if you want to risk it and tame it and it also has special abilities and it will help you A LOT

also if you want to make the omega deminsion portal make it as the same nether portal but with the omega void block and get the omega void mace and set the special power to lightning and strike it down and it will light up ! 

1.0.3 update!!!

added a new tier (meteor)

added a special event : its a super rare event that happens which is a meteor falls so fast from the sky and you can go there after it falls and break the meteor with an omega pickaxe
which will give you a meteor ore
you can make armor - tool of meteor ingot 
and it has special supernatural powers and the sword have a storage that auto collects the loot you get after you kill mobs and you can open it by holding left shift and pressing right click and you can stack same item up to 999 in one slot .

i also recommend installing jei (just enough items) alongside the mod so you can be comfortable and play easily while not having to memorize all of that ( not important anymore after the 1.0.2 update)

and hopefully you will enjoy this mod and tell me for more things you want me to do also and i will do it right away and ill keep updating the mod with more and more if i find that people likes it 

enjoy ❤️
